scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Explainer out/notifyd-explainer.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20
scripts.render:shorts: for c in ShortOneCall ShortNothingLost ShortAgentOnCall ShortLess; do remotion render src/index.ts $c out/$(echo $c | sed 's/Short//; s/\([A-Z]\)/-\L\1/g; s/^-//; s/^/short/').mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20; done
scripts.render:films: for c in FilmThreeWays:film-three-ways FilmOne:film-one FilmTalk:film-talk FilmNumbers:film-numbers; do remotion render src/index.ts ${c%%:*} out/${c##*:}.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20; done
scripts.render:clear: remotion render src/index.ts Clear out/film-clear.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20
scripts.render:sober: remotion render src/index.ts SoberTerminal out/film-terminal.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 19 && remotion render src/index.ts SoberDiagram out/film-diagram.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 19
scripts.render:mix: remotion render src/index.ts SoberMix out/film-mix.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 19
scripts.render:final: remotion render src/index.ts SoberFinal out/film-final-raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 && ffmpeg -y -i out/film-final-raw.mp4 -f lavfi -i anullsrc=channel_layout=stereo:sample_rate=48000 -shortest -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -profile:v high -level 4.1 -crf 18 -preset slow -c:a aac -b:a 64k -movflags +faststart out/film-final.mp4
